label: Same-bearer existence dictionary for the selected formula
paraphrase: OPEN dictionary bridge: at every world of the same Ontic frame, the selected formula in the selected valuation holds exactly when the same rigid candidate n exists. Thus selected-interpretation NECESSARY_8 boxing of that formula transfers to NECESSARY_2 box-existence of this same bearer, retaining the identical frame and accessible worlds. This is an explicit assumption, not an identification of arbitrary formula meanings with existence.
